description: LAOLA Movement was founded in 2023 by Taty, a German born, Ireland based certified Pilates instructor with a love for movement, connection, and the outdoors. Her mission? It perfectly reflects the brand’s philosophy: to move together, to celebrate our bodies, and to ride life’s waves — on the mat and beyond. What began as a handful of outdoor classes quickly grew into a growing movement in the local community. Today, LAOLA offers a mix of outdoor group classes in summer , online sessions in winter , and one-of-a-kind Pilates events that bring like-minded souls together — from sea swims to paddleboarding and even Pilates with alpacas. Taty is YMCA accredited through Reformation Studio (Dublin), with additional qualifications in Ante & Postnatal Pilates (APPI, London 2024) and an ongoing focus on women’s health and the transitions women go through across life stages. Every class is led by her personally, blending technical precision with fun, human connection. Whether you're a curious beginner or a seasoned mover, LAOLA Movement welcomes all genders and levels . Taty creates a space that’s equal parts grounding and uplifting—rooted in movement, laughter, and community care. Outdoor events include: Outdoor Pilates & Sea Swims (every Monday 7pm!) Beach Pilates, Sea Swim & Sauna (next one coming up in August) Sunset Pilates & Stand-Up Paddleboarding (next one coming up soon!) Yes, humor belongs in your wellness journey, too. 📍 For the latest class schedule and a healthy dose of Pilates inspiration, follow @laola_movement. 📩 Booking via Wunderbook or email: laola.movement@gmail.com or this link tree 🌊 Taty can’t wait to welcome you on the mat—or in the sea. description: We offer a fun and thrill packed pack week of surfing. Each day’s two hour session will allow your children to gain confidence and skills in the water. description: Join the World's No. 1 Preschool Football Program and join over 100,000 children participating every week. Our play orientated classes are fun, engaging and nurture a love of sport from an early age. We are proud to be More Than Just Football and while football is the tool we use our goal ism to develop - the Fundamental of Movement (balance, agility & coordination) - Fundamental Movement skills ( running, hopping, skipping, jumping) - Social skills such as listening, sharing, taking turns - Early Learning concepts like numbers, colours, body parts We have 4 different age groups to ensure children participate with their peers in and around the same development level. Our Little Kicks program is suitable for children aged 18 months to 2.5. It is a parent toddler program and active parental participation is required. This ensures your child gets the very best out of the sessions. Learning to learn is the goal at this level so learning to listen, learning to follow instructions and our engaging fun games facilitate this. Our Junior Kickers classes are for 2.5 to 3.5 year olds. Children are starting to get more independent at this stage. Parents will see them participating more by themselves however many will still like to have their parents close to them at the magic wall. Play, Practice, Understand is the learning outcome at this level. The next stage in the program is the Mighty Kickers suitable for 3.5 to 5 year olds. Most children participate independently in these classes with parents encouraged to support from the sidelines. Our Play, Practice, Understand is further developed in this stage. The Mega Kickers program brings together all the learning outcomes from the previous levels. There is a big step up with the classes relying less on the play orientated structure of the earlier stages and with a 20 minute match at the end of each session it's preparing children to move onto football academies and continue their football journey Throughout all stages our core philosophy of Play not Push is embodied. We believe children should be gently encouraged to participate and allowed to watch if they are unsure. We hope that by seeing the other children in the class participating they will be spurred on to join in the fun.

description: SwimCamp is offers intensive swimming camps for children throughout the year at Castle Park School Swimming Pool in Dalkey, Dublin. These camps are designed for kids aged 5 and up who have some previous swimming experience. The classes usually lasting 45 minutes each day. The camps are divided into three skill levels (Group 1, 2, and 3) to accommodate different abilities, from beginners to more advanced swimmers. There are also special clinics for teens aged 13+. Children can be accompanied by any caregiver - parents, grandparents, or childminders. However, the website doesn't specify whether caregivers are required to stay for the duration of the class. It's best to contact SwimCamp directly for clarification on this point. Regarding what to bring or wear, the website doesn't provide specific information. Typically for swim classes, children should bring: A well-fitting swimsuit A towel Goggles (if preferred) A swim cap (if required by the pool) It's advisable to contact SwimCamp for any specific requirements or recommendations they might have for their classes. Each camp consists of three 45-minute sessions held on consecutive days. The camps focus on improving existing swimming skills, building confidence in the water, and teaching water safety. Experienced, certified coaches lead small groups to ensure personalized attention. SwimCamp emphasizes a fun and engaging learning environment while helping children develop essential swimming strokes, strength, and endurance. The camps are priced at €65 for the three-day session. Parents interested in enrolling their children can choose from multiple dates and time slots throughout July and August.

description: Join Aoife for a gentle and nurturing baby massage course designed to help you bond with your baby while learning a valuable skill that can support relaxation, sleep, digestion and communication. Over the course, you will learn a full baby massage routine, techniques to help with common discomforts such as wind and constipation, and how massage can support your baby's emotional and physical wellbeing. Classes are baby-led, relaxed and welcoming, with plenty of time for feeding, cuddles and nappy changes whenever needed. As well as learning massage techniques, you'll have the opportunity to connect with other parents and caregivers in a supportive environment. Thursdays 10-10.45am Redeemer Family Resource Centre, Dundalk Baby massage classes are suitable for babies from approximately 6 weeks of age until they become actively mobile. Mums, dads, grandparents and other primary caregivers are welcome to attend with baby. One adult attends with each baby. This is a caregiver-and-baby class, and the attending adult must remain with their baby for the full duration of the session. Please bring: * A towel or blanket for your baby to lie on * Any feeding supplies you may need * Nappies and wipes * A spare change of clothes for baby Babies should wear comfortable clothing that is easy to remove for massage. Massage oil will be provided. Please don't worry if your baby sleeps, feeds, cries or needs extra cuddles during class. Baby massage is always baby-led, and you're welcome to follow your baby's cues throughout the session. I look forward to welcoming you and your baby for a relaxed and enjoyable experience together.

description: Play and Create by Art Room 109 Classes are designed for parents and walking toddlers aged 1 to 5. These 60-minute sessions are flexible to fit your little one’s routine—arrive and leave at a time that suits you. The final 10 minutes feature bubbles, music, and parachute play. Each session is thoughtfully crafted to engage both parents and toddlers in a fun and dynamic way. With up to six different open-ended art stations, this is a completely child-led class focused on play-based learning and the development of fine motor, social, and creative skills. Parents must accompany and supervise their child throughout, as classes are fully child-led with no formal teaching—my role is to guide and facilitate creativity. All sensory materials are freshly homemade, natural, and taste-safe. Washable, non-toxic paints are used, and we recommend dressing children in pre-loved clothes. These laid-back sessions encourage connection with other parents and the community while inspiring simple creative play you can try at home. Based in Kinvara, Co. Galway, Art Room 109 travels up to one hour from H91 N5P2 to bring creative workshops to schools, community centres, and private venues. Current Class Locations: Maree, Oranmore: Tuesdays and one Sunday a month Kinvara: Fridays glór, Ennis: Thursdays (once a month from 2025) To view the class timetable and book a class, visit buk.ie/109. description: Galway Community Circus was created to meet the needs of our local youth by offering a non-competitive, physical and creative activity in a safe and welcoming space. Our philosophy is ‘circus for all’, and we use the circus arts to teach young people, including those who are disadvantaged, at-risk and vulnerable, the tools to develop self-confidence, resilience and social skills while tapping into strengths and hidden talents. Circus classes offer something for everyone to enjoy and are suitable for all ages, levels and abilities. At Galway Community Circus, we offer multiple classes for ages 1-17 years (and adults 18+ too!) Our main location is in Shantalla on Galway's Westside, but we also offer classes in Renmore on Galway's Eastside as well as in Tuam. We offer Toddler Circus classes for ages 1-4 years with an adult on Mondays, Thursdays and Saturdays in Shantalla and on Fridays in Renmore. In our Toddler Circus classes, adults are welcome to participate, but are not required, however they must stay in the class. description: Join the World's No. 1 Preschool Football Program and join over 100,000 children participating every week. Our play orientated classes are fun, engaging and nurture a love of sport from an early age. We are proud to be More Than Just Football and while football is the tool we use our goal ism to develop - the Fundamental of Movement (balance, agility & coordination) - Fundamental Movement skills ( running, hopping, skipping, jumping) - Social skills such as listening, sharing, taking turns - Early Learning concepts like numbers, colours, body parts We have 4 different age groups to ensure children participate with their peers in and around the same development level. Our Little Kicks program is suitable for children aged 18 months to 2.5. It is a parent toddler program and active parental participation is required. This ensures your child gets the very best out of the sessions. Learning to learn is the goal at this level so learning to listen, learning to follow instructions and our engaging fun games facilitate this. Our Junior Kickers classes are for 2.5 to 3.5 year olds. Children are starting to get more independent at this stage. Parents will see them participating more by themselves however many will still like to have their parents close to them at the magic wall. Play, Practice, Understand is the learning outcome at this level. The next stage in the program is the Mighty Kickers suitable for 3.5 to 5 year olds. Most children participate independently in these classes with parents encouraged to support from the sidelines. Our Play, Practice, Understand is further developed in this stage. The Mega Kickers program brings together all the learning outcomes from the previous levels. There is a big step up with the classes relying less on the play orientated structure of the earlier stages and with a 20 minute match at the end of each session it's preparing children to move onto football academies and continue their football journey Throughout all stages our core philosophy of Play not Push is embodied. We believe children should be gently encouraged to participate and allowed to watch if they are unsure. We hope that by seeing the other children in the class participating they will be spurred on to join in the fun.

description: Join the World's No. 1 Preschool Football Program and join over 100,000 children participating every week. Our play orientated classes are fun, engaging and nurture a love of sport from an early age. We are proud to be More Than Just Football and while football is the tool we use our goal ism to develop - the Fundamental of Movement (balance, agility & coordination) - Fundamental Movement skills ( running, hopping, skipping, jumping) - Social skills such as listening, sharing, taking turns - Early Learning concepts like numbers, colours, body parts We have 4 different age groups to ensure children participate with their peers in and around the same development level. Our Little Kicks program is suitable for children aged 18 months to 2.5. It is a parent toddler program and active parental participation is required. This ensures your child gets the very best out of the sessions. Learning to learn is the goal at this level so learning to listen, learning to follow instructions and our engaging fun games facilitate this. Our Junior Kickers classes are for 2.5 to 3.5 year olds. Children are starting to get more independent at this stage. Parents will see them participating more by themselves however many will still like to have their parents close to them at the magic wall. Play, Practice, Understand is the learning outcome at this level. The next stage in the program is the Mighty Kickers suitable for 3.5 to 5 year olds. Most children participate independently in these classes with parents encouraged to support from the sidelines. Our Play, Practice, Understand is further developed in this stage. The Mega Kickers program brings together all the learning outcomes from the previous levels. There is a big step up with the classes relying less on the play orientated structure of the earlier stages and with a 20 minute match at the end of each session it's preparing children to move onto football academies and continue their football journey Throughout all stages our core philosophy of Play not Push is embodied. We believe children should be gently encouraged to participate and allowed to watch if they are unsure. We hope that by seeing the other children in the class participating they will be spurred on to join in the fun.

description: Welcome to Toddle On, where parents and children can bond in a warm and friendly environment. Toddle On play café is a warm, welcoming space where babies and young children can play, explore and learn while parents and carers can relax and connect. Play space is suitable for 0-10 year olds. We offer themed sensory and messy play classes for children aged 2 months to 6 years, designed to support early development through music, movement, storytelling and hands-on play. Classes are tailored by age group and include popular activities such as foam messy play, creative trays and imaginative role-play, all in a safe, nurturing environment. Our activities are thoughtfully crafted to provide your child with an enriching early learning experience while also fostering new friendships in the community. Come join us for a memorable time! Want to know more about the play space? Our play café consists of your rooms: 🌈 Sensory Play Room A calm, engaging space designed especially for babies and toddlers. This room features soft play, lights, textures and sensory toys that encourage early development, curiosity and gentle exploration in a relaxed environment. 🎭 Imaginative Play Room Perfect for little imaginations, this room allows children to role-play and create their own adventures. From pretend play to dressing up and themed setups, it supports social skills, confidence and creative thinking. A comfortable, welcoming area for parents and carers to relax while keeping an eye on their little ones. Enjoy a coffee, chat with other parents and take a breather while your children play safely nearby. 🎨 Creative & Messy Play Classroom A hands-on space where children are encouraged to explore, create and get messy. This room supports fine motor skills and learning through play — without the mess at home! 🎯Games Room The Games Room offers older children a dedicated space to enjoy a mix of active games and imaginative play. From basketball, mini snooker and football to creative play with Barbie, Paw Patrol, superheroes, puppets and dress-up, this room keeps older siblings happily engaged. Our Classes Toddle On Teenies Nurture your bond with your baby through our Toddle On Teenies program. With baby sensory activities, baby beats, lámh and baby massage, you and your little one will create lasting memories while supporting your baby's development. Toddle On Tinies Bond with your growing baby at Toddle On with our Toddle On Tinies program. Explore the world of baby sensory, lámh, messy play and music, using instruments to engage with your little one and bond over a weekly theme. Create lasting memories with your baby at Toddle On. Toddle On Tots Let your tot unleash their artistic imagination at Toddle On with our Toddle on Tots program. Each week, your child will delve into a new theme while learning a new sound, exploring messy play, role play, stories, numeracy, lámh, music, and crafts. Watch your tot develop and grow while having fun in a welcoming and engaging environment. Based in DB fitness and injuries, Unit 5 Pinewood Business Park (beside Lidl in Clonard). Various times depending on child’s age, please see booking page for times. When you book a play session you can drop in anytime that day within the opening hours. All caregivers welcome, required to stay for duration. All resources provided, refreshments available to purchase. Sibling discounts and memberships available. For baby classes advised to have easily accessible outfit for baby massage. For older classes messy play involved so best not to wear a new outfit. Got a birthday coming up? Have full use of the play space and a bubble disco for the amazing price of €100 and have your party with us. Snack bags available to purchase to use as your party bags.

description: Hello and welcome to Moo Music Wicklow! The home of MOOsical fun for the under 5's. We sing, we dance, we moove, we learn and we have fun!
